title: 篡改历史，日本右翼否定战后定论祸患不断（寰宇平）
title_en: Distorting history, Japan's right-wing denial of postwar conclusions brings endless trouble (Huan Yuping)
summary: 文章指出，东京审判依法判定日本军国主义发动侵略战争、追究战犯责任，构成战后国际秩序与日本重返国际社会的重要法理基础。但日本右翼势力长期试图否定审判，炮制“胜者对败者的裁决”“事后法”“自虐史观”等说辞，并参拜靖国神社、篡改历史教科书、美化军
summary_en: The article points out that the Tokyo Trial legally determined that Japanese militarism launched a war of aggression and held war criminals accountable, constituting an important legal foundation for the post-war international order and Japan's return to the international community. However, right-wing forces in Japan have long tried to deny the trial, fabricating rhetoric such as "victor's justice over the vanquished," "ex post facto law," and a "masochistic view of history," while also visiting Yasukuni Shrine, tampering with history textbooks, and glorifying militarism.

title: 全球极端天气频发  亟待各方协力应对（国际视点）
title_en: Extreme weather frequent worldwide; urgent joint response needed (International Perspective)
summary: 今年夏季，欧洲、亚洲、北美多地遭遇创纪录高温、干旱、山火和暴雨洪水。欧盟气候监测机构数据显示，7月全球地表气温较工业化前高1.47摄氏度，海洋表面温度创同期新高。西欧经历最热6、7月，法国山火致22万人疏散，莱茵河等航道低水位影响航运和能源
summary_en: This summer, Europe, Asia, and North America experienced record heat, drought, wildfires, and torrential floods. EU climate monitoring data show that July global surface temperatures were 1.47°C above pre-industrial levels, and ocean surface temperatures hit a record high for the period. Western Europe had its hottest June and July; wildfires in France forced 220,000 evacuations, and low water levels on the Rhine and other waterways affected shipping and energy supplies.

summary_en: Laos has recently intensified its crackdown on telecom and online fraud. title: 雅万高铁上半年列车正点率达99.4%，客户满意度保持高位
title_en: Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Railway achieves 99.4% punctuality in H1, customer satisfaction remains high
summary: 据印尼中国高速铁路有限公司数据，2026年上半年雅万高铁累计开行列车10640列次，其中10574列次正点运行，正点率达99.4%，保持较高运行水平。同期客户满意度调查显示，旅客对整体服务平均满意度为95.79%，其中对列车正点表现满意度最
summary_en: According to data from PT KCIC, in the first half of 2026 the Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Railway operated a total of 10,640 train trips, of which 10,574 ran on time, for an on-time rate of 99.4%, maintaining a high operating level. A customer satisfaction survey over the same period showed average passenger satisfaction with overall service was 95.79%, with the highest satisfaction for on-time performance.

title: 为亚洲篮球注入活力（竞技观察）
title_en: Injecting vitality into Asian basketball (Sports Observation)
summary: 2026亚洲大学生篮球联赛8月11日在杭州结束，上海交通大学队以72∶69险胜台湾政治大学队夺冠，球员陈天灿获最佳球员。本届赛事国际化进程加速，中国高校球队由7支调整至5支，新增澳大利亚、菲律宾、日本、韩国、蒙古国等6支球队，不同风格球队同
summary_en: The 2026 Asian University Basketball League concluded on August 11 in Hangzhou, with Shanghai Jiao Tong University defeating Taiwan's Chengchi University 72-69 to win the championship; player Chen Tiancan was named MVP. The tournament's internationalization accelerated: Chinese university teams were reduced from 7 to 5, and six new teams from Australia, the Philippines, Japan, South Korea, and Mongolia were added, allowing teams of different styles to compete.

title: “专心做好技术攻关这件事”（我在中国创业）
title_en: "Focus on tackling key technologies" (My Startup in China)
summary: 德国工程师科瑞斯与中国妻子蒋筱桦2023年到江苏太仓创办小科智行，专注研发新能源汽车空气悬架压缩机。此前他发现该部件技术老旧、响应迟缓，德国创业困难，遂选择中国。太仓政府提供政策指南、专人帮办和人才扶持，使其专心技术攻关；当地产业链配套高效
summary_en: German engineer Kris and his Chinese wife Jiang Xiaohua came to Taicang, Jiangsu in 2023 to found Xiaoke Zhixing, focusing on R&D of air suspension compressors for new energy vehicles. He had previously found the technology outdated and slow to respond, and starting a business in Germany difficult, so he chose China. The Taicang government provided policy guidance, dedicated assistance and talent support, enabling him to focus on technical breakthroughs; local supply chain support is efficient.
